description: This file configures the Axios HTTP client for API interactions, including URL resolution, token management, and request/response interceptors for a React-based web application. It contains utility functions for environment-based URL normalization and handles special cases such as the Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a given URL or path to prevent double-slash issues.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1', appending it if necessary.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is within the Kavia preview environment based on hostname.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the public origin URL in a Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment-configured base URLs for consistency, handling relative paths and preview environment tweaks.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL based on environment variables and environment-specific rules.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes the '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL if present.
